lines.say: Twenty percent of the pods in his garden held eighty percent of the peas.
caps: *20%* of the pods in his garden

lines.say: That became the eighty twenty rule.
In a shop, usually about twenty percent of clients pay most of the bills.
Do you know who they are?
Check when each one last came in. Text the quiet ones first.
caps: Check when each one *last came in.*

lines.say: Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
